title: 飛機雷擊防護架構
summary: 以「從外表面導電路徑追到線束耦合與設備抗擾證據」為主線，在低能量搭接與電磁相容桌上實驗室中依序完成表面接片與四線式搭接證據、線束回路的間接耦合、回流接頭的阻抗分配、瞬變記錄的取樣盲點、防護分區與試驗證據矩陣及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Trace surface conduction through harness coupling to equipment-immunity evidence in a Low-energy bonding and EMC tabletop laboratory, progressing through Surface straps and four-wire evidence, Indirect coupling into harness loops, Return-connector impedance allocation, Sampling blind spots in transient records, Protection-zone evidence matrix, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 表面接片與四線式搭接證據：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Surface straps and four-wire evidence: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 表面接片與四線式搭接證據 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Surface straps and four-wire evidence and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機雷擊防護架構」中，本單元處理「表面接片與四線式搭接證據」。接觸面氧化、緊固狀態和導電接片共同決定接點電阻；外觀相接不代表電位相同。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft lightning-protection architecture, this unit examines Surface straps and four-wire evidence. Oxidation, fastening condition and conductive straps determine joint resistance; physical contact does not guarantee equal potential.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：測試電流 I=2 A、搭接電阻 R=0.004 Ω。關係式 V=IR；含輸出單位換算的算式 2*0.004，結果 0.008 V。適用範圍：低電流直流教學測試；不可把這個結果外推為雷擊脈衝耐受能力。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Test current I=2 A and bond resistance R=0.004 ohm. Relation V=IR; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 2*0.004 gives 0.008 V. Applicability: Low-current DC teaching test; this does not establish lightning-impulse endurance.
steps.failure: 在「表面接片與四線式搭接證據」的情境中，探針接觸不良可能被誤判成搭接劣化；先用已知參考電阻排除量測問題。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Surface straps and four-wire evidence, Poor probe contact can resemble joint degradation; first rule out measurement error with a known reference.
steps.check: 針對「表面接片與四線式搭接證據」，比較四線式讀值與兩線式讀值，標出導線和接點對結果的貢獻。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Surface straps and four-wire evidence, Compare four-wire and two-wire readings and separate lead resistance from joint resistance. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 R 改為0.010 Ω，其餘條件固定。用 2*0.010 重算，結果從 0.008 變成 0.02 V。先預測方向，再記下對「表面接片與四線式搭接證據」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only R to 0.010 ohm, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 2*0.010: 0.008 becomes 0.02 V. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Surface straps and four-wire evidence, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「飛機雷擊防護架構」的「表面接片與四線式搭接證據：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Surface straps and four-wire evidence: Mechanism and observation” in “Aircraft lightning-protection architecture”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 在「飛機雷擊防護架構」中，本單元處理「導電網中的局部熱量負擔」。電阻中的能量與電流平方及作用時間有關；電流短暫加倍也會顯著增加熱負荷。

steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: I=5 A, R=0.2 ohm and t=10 s. quiz.explanation: 在「導電網中的局部熱量負擔」的情境中，只用平均電流平方會低估脈動電流的發熱，應比較均方值。 針對「導電網中的局部熱量負擔」，用合成電流時間序列分段加總 I²RΔt，與矩形脈衝結果比較。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
quiz.explanationEn: In the context of Local energy loading in conductive mesh, Squaring mean current can underestimate pulsating-current heating; compare mean-square current. For Local energy loading in conductive mesh, Sum I²RΔt over a synthetic current trace and compare with the rectangular-pulse result. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.
